thread:
Alex Kim: Quick sync — Q1 recurring-incident patterns review. I'm drafting remediation owners/timelines for the top recurring causes we keep seeing. Top 3 recurring causes from the last 6 months: 1) cache thrash on prefix-heavy workloads, 2) autoscale delay leading to queueing, 3) model fallback mismatch causing higher latency/error variance. Proposed owners and rough timelines below. Any objections? I'll open action items in the PM board after we agree.

Priya Desai: I can take cache thrash (PM-412). Plan: reproduce with synthetic traces, add KV cache health metrics, propose a circuit-breaker + sticky routing. ETA: 3w for proposal, 8w for rollout. Will need eng-runtime support and a small eval harness.

Jordan Lee: I'll own autoscale delay (PM-419). Quick wins: tune cooldowns, add warm standby pool for predictable peak warm-ups, and improve scaling trigger sensitivity. ETA: 2w for config changes, 6w for integration and stress tests. Tagging @Sam Ortega for infra capacity.

Sam Ortega: ack. I'll own warm standby and capacity (INF-33). Need a capacity estimate — will produce numbers today. Heads-up: may need a short finance approval for temporary 2x standby nodes.

Alex Kim: For model fallback mismatch (PM-427) propose: restrict fallback to quantized variant only when observed per-token latency < 120ms on the route, and gate by evaluation suite to avoid semantic regressions. Owner suggestion: Priya (coord) + Research (correctness gating).

Priya Desai: happy to coordinate evals, but Research should own the correctness gate. @Jordan Lee can you add a per-route rollout flag that ties to the eval pass?

Jordan Lee: yep — adding rollout flag support. Example config snippet I’ll use for canary policy: ```routes:
  - name: chat-prod
    rollout:
      variant: quantized-v2
      threshold_ms: 120
      eval_suite: semantic-smoke
```

Oncall Bot: New recurring-patterns ticket created: RP-2026 — linked to PM-412, PM-419, PM-427.

Alex Kim: Let's capture measurable success metrics per action: cache thrash -> reduce prefix-related KV miss storms and improve 95th/99th token latency by at least 20%. Autoscale -> reduce queued requests (90th/95th) to near-zero during spikes. Model fallback -> reduce semantic regression incidents by 70% and maintain >=95% fidelity on smoke eval. I’ll add these to the exec deck.

Priya Desai: timeline + owners look good to me. I'll create the cards in the PM board (link to board) and tag stakeholders.

Sam Ortega: FYI finance greenlit temporary standby for 4 weeks to complete testing, then we'll reassess cost/benefit.

Jordan Lee: I'll post weekly updates in this thread and add a small dashboard widget to Console showing queue length, autoscale events, and fallback rates.

Alex Kim: Great — I'll create the follow-up triage meeting invite for Monday 09:30. Agenda: owners signoff, blockers, test plans, and rollout gating. Thanks all :thumbsup:
